site_title: Color Memory — A minimal color memory game
site_description: See a color. Memorize it. Rebuild it. A minimal test of visual memory and perception, scored in perceptual color space.
play_description: Memorize a full-screen color, then rebuild it from memory and see how close you got.
play_og_description: Memorize a color, rebuild it, and score your perception.
home_tagline: How well can you remember a color?
mode_speed_description: The color disappears faster every round.
mode_precision_description: Steady time. Colors get harder to tell apart.
mode_endless_description: Keep going until you stop — or miss too often.
